facts.fact: An insured woman gets maternity benefit for 26 weeks
facts.quote: How long? 26 weeks Can it be extended? Yes, by one more month, if a doctor advises it (for example, for complications).

facts.fact: It can be extended by one more month on medical advice (e.g. complications)
facts.quote: Can it be extended? Yes, by one more month, if a doctor advises it (for example, for complications).

facts.fact: It is paid at the full wage
facts.quote: How much? Your full wage Who can claim? A woman who has paid contributions for 70 days in the last two contribution periods.

facts.fact: Eligibility: contributions paid for 70 days in the two preceding contribution periods
facts.quote: Who can claim? A woman who has paid contributions for 70 days in the last two contribution periods.

facts.fact: Adopting and commissioning mothers get 12 weeks from the date the child is handed over
facts.quote: Insured woman shall be entitled to twelve weeks of maternity benefit from the date the child is handed over to the commissioning mother after birth or adopting mother, as the case may be.

facts.fact: Miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy: 6 weeks from the date of the event
facts.quote: Miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy: 6 weeks from the day it happens.

facts.fact: Sickness arising from pregnancy, confinement, premature birth, miscarriage or MTP: up to 1 more month
facts.quote: Sickness arises out of pregnancy, confinement, premature birth of child or miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy: Up to 1 more month.

facts.fact: A medical bonus of Rs 15,000 per case is paid for confinement at a place without ESI medical facilities
facts.quote: an insured woman and an Insured Person in respect of his wife shall be paid a sum of rupees fifteen thousand per case as medical bonus

facts.fact: Maternity benefit cannot be drawn together with sickness or temporary disablement benefit for the same days
facts.quote: One benefit at a time: You cannot receive maternity benefit and sickness benefit together for the same days. The same applies to maternity benefit and temporary disablement benefit.

facts.fact: Maternity benefit from ESIC cannot also be claimed from the employer
facts.quote: No double claim: If you are eligible for maternity benefit from ESIC, you cannot also claim it from your employer.

summary: ESIC Information-Benefits page (Code on Social Security text) still confirms 26 weeks, +1 month, full wage, 70 days, 12 weeks adoption, 6 weeks MTP, Rs 15,000 medical bonus; all confirmed.
